color.summary: Neutrals in LCH with a faint blue cast, in three layers: the shell behind the sidebar (#efeff0 light, #09090a dark), the content panel (#f9f9fa, #121213) and raised cards, menus and fields (#fff, #1a1a1b to #212122). Ink is #1b1b1b with #303032 for secondary text and #5e5e60 for muted (#fff, #e4e5e7 and #98999c in dark); edges #e4e4e4 (#303132). The one accent is indigo, #6d78d5 in light and #5e6ad2 in dark, for primary buttons, focus and the selected key. Red #e2253b (#ff8683) marks destructive actions and green #27a644 (#41ba56) what is turned on.

type.summary: Inter Variable at 400, 450, 500 and 600, with Berkeley Mono for code and identifiers (12px on 20px). Navigation and labels are 13px at 500, menu rows 13px at 400 on 19.5px, buttons and chips 12px at 500. Settings titles are 24px at 500 on 30px, section headings 15px at 500. An issue's title is 24px at 600 with -0.1px tracking, 18px in the Create issue dialog.

shape.summary: Buttons, chips and tabs are pills and icon buttons circles. Sidebar rows, fields, selects and search boxes have 8px corners, as do integration cards; the composer 10px, menus 12px, keyboard keys 4px.

spacing.summary: A 2px grid. Most controls are 28px: sidebar rows (10px sides), icon buttons, pill buttons and chips; small ones are 24px. Settings buttons and fields are 32px with 12px sides, selects 30px with 10px. Menu rows are 32px with 14px sides; ⌘K rows 46px with 12px.

elevation.summary: Flat layers set apart by tone, with light drops on what is raised: 0 3px 6px -2px at 2% and 0 1px 1px at 4% under cards, the composer, search boxes and primary buttons; cards add a 1px ring at 3%. In dark these become one 0 0.5px 1px 1px drop at 30%. Menus float on 0 6px 18px at 2%, 0 3px 9px at 4% and 0 1px 1px at 4% (three layers at 12.5% in dark).

button.summary: Pills at 12px and 500 (13px at the 32px size), ghost unless they carry an action of weight: primary fills indigo, secondary is white in a 1px #e4e4e4 edge. Ghost buttons take the color of the layer they sit on, so the census splits them by layer: the shell behind the sidebar and the content panel.

provenance.notes: Written block by block from the census (spec.json, census 4fcf712) and its frozen copies: 35 signed-in pages of the Linear app in light and dark (inbox, my issues, an issue, projects, initiatives, views, the agent, Settings), read in Mehdi's research Chrome on a near-empty workspace, with menus, ⌘K and Create issue opened. Signed-in text is redacted in the copies, so parts were named from their layout, icons and values; focus and sizes in the pack's sources.md agree. Names marked ai are ours; primary and default are Linear's data-variant values.
